description: THE NETWORK'S BOARD (rokha.ai/network/incubation · /network/members) — ONE board: builders and promoters ranked together on one Attention score this round — built (distinct others ran your listings), operated, brought (referrals who then ran something), scouted (confirmed audits), sold, plus pin_points (verified Pin of the Week days, promoters). Each row carries rank, points by lane, its ticket (ran for a distinct other or roster promoter · payout wallet · audit clean), `lane` (builder | promoter — information only), `pin_points`, `page_url` and the payout line (null while preview). The week's top 10 are the Network Members and the ONLY rows paid — USDC every Friday 22:00 UTC from 2026-10-16 on a fixed table (1st $30 · 2nd $20 · 3rd $16 · 4th–10th $12; `pot.table_usd`). Incubation earns House resources, not cash. Nobody is paid for a post. `section` = 'incubation' (default) or 'members'; `week` = the round's Friday (YYYY-MM-DD), default the current round.

week.description: The round's Friday, YYYY-MM-DD; omit for the current round.
